# Webapp Source Instructions

- Follow `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` **Required Workflow** (issue → branch →
  draft PR before implementation).
- Author application styles in SCSS only; use
  [docs/styling-and-technology.md](../../docs/styling-and-technology.md) and
  `src/styles/bootstrap-theme.scss` as the theme entrypoint.
- Preserve module boundaries per
  [docs/architecture/ddd-decision.md](../../docs/architecture/ddd-decision.md).
- For UI changes, follow [docs/accessibility.md](../../docs/accessibility.md).
